name: Gravitational Lensing
description: Stylized gravitational-lensing distortion with held-pointer pull, orbiting horizon runners, inward light packets, audio modulation, and bounded click fronts.

name: Bubble Lens
description: A thin-film soap bubble lens magnifies the source image and blooms into beat-reactive interference colors around the cursor.

name: Complex Exponent Warp
description: Applies a complex domain distortion z -> z^p with FBM pre-warp, mouse-driven exponent, depth-aware fog, chromatic aberration, and ACES tone mapping.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Zoom scale into the complex plane

params.name: Exponent Spread
params.description: Spread of the complex exponent from mouse position

params.name: UV Warp Scale
params.description: Scale of the FBM domain warp and output UV warp

name: Crystal Facets
description: Physical crystal refraction with light transmission. Simulates radial-cut crystal with proper Fresnel reflection, internal scattering from fractures, and chromatic dispersion based on refractive index.

params.name: Crystal Thickness
params.description: Physical thickness affecting light path and absorption

name: Cyber Lens
description: AR-style cybernetic lens with cyan holographic HUD, targeting reticle, scan lines, hex threat zones, glitch artifacts, chromatic aberration, and depth-parallax layers. Bass drives HUD flicker; mouse moves the reticle; depth controls layer parallax.

name: Data Slicer
description: Beat-reactive fractal tape-slice glitch with FBM domain warping, Voronoi cellular cracks, quasicrystal patterns, and 6-octave temporal jitter. Slices distort organically with curl-noise chromatic aberration and audio-reactive sparkle trails.

name: Dimension Slicer
description: Opens a dimensional rift with temporal slice rotation memory, chromatic inside-slice dispersion, audio-driven slice width modulation, depth-aware zoom warp, and edge glow.

name: Elastic Strip
description: Spring physics strips with beveled sub-ribs, traveling pluck packets, soap-film color from stretch energy, held drag, and bounded click plucks. Display RGBA is packed in A.

name: Elastic Surface
description: Spring-mass elastic membrane with wave propagation, surface tension coupling, depth-aware deformation, and ripple-reactive impulses.

name: Ethereal Swirl
description: Ethereal swirling motion with soft gradients.

name: Fluid Grid
description: Flowing grid distortion with fluid dynamics.

name: IFS Attractor Glass
description: IFS attractor glass with branch runners, held contraction pinch, treble iridescence, and capped attractor shock rings.

name: Fractal Image Surf
description: Multi-octave FBM domain warping with Jacobian-preserving displacement. Morphs between Julia, Mandelbrot, and Burning Ship fractals driven by bass.

name: Fractal Kaleidoscope
description: Fractal kaleidoscope with live sliders, facet seams, radial conveyors, held pivot, bounded iris clicks, and oil-slick color. Display RGBA in A.

name: Gemstone Fractures
description: Fragments the image into crystalline shards with physical light transmission. Features internal fractures that scatter light, variable purity per cell, and IOR-based refraction.

params.name: Fracture Density
params.description: Internal fractures: 0 = pure crystal, 1 = heavily fractured

name: Chromatic Vortex
description: Rotates image in polar coordinates with psychedelic color-space warping, chromatic sector dispersion, temporal spiral drift via dataTextureC, and audio-driven YUV hue rotation.

name: Glass Brick Distortion
description: Physical glass brick wall with per-channel IOR chromatic dispersion (Snell's law), Schlick-Fresnel highlights, Beer-Lambert absorption, depth-aware thickness, audio-reactive refraction pulse, and ripple-driven brick wobble. Mouse cursor clears a window through the glass.

name: Glass Brick Wall
description: Refractive glass brick wall with FBM-perturbed normals, multi-frequency caustic patterns, chromatic dispersion through wavelength-dependent refraction, depth-layer compositing, and internal reflections. Beat-driven caustics and Voronoi cellular caustic enhancement.

name: Glitch Slice Mirror
description: Mirrors the image at the mouse position with digital glitch artifacts, chromatic aberration, and scanlines along the seam. Audio-reactive intensity boost.

name: Gravity Well
description: Schwarzschild-inspired lensing with photon-sphere rings, gravitational redshift, and Doppler-bright accretion flow.

name: Heat Haze Mirage gpt52
description: Rising heat mirage with thermal filaments, axial packets, held thermal source, bounded click rings, chromatic dispersion, and oil-slick shimmer. Display RGBA in A; 16x16x1.

name: Heat Haze
description: Stylized heat distortion with exact-load rising heat advection, fast convection packets, held-pointer injection, click thermal fronts, diffusion, and audio shimmer.

name: Infinite Zoom Lens
description: Droste zoom lens with axial packets, interference runners, analytic rainbow caustics, held aim, click rings. Diagnostic A packing preserved.

name: Interactive RGB Split
description: Smooth alpha-channel translucency blending driven by a single displacement field. Spectral tint via mix, depth-aware compositing, and audio-reactive bass response.

name: Interactive Zoom Blur
description: Radial zoom blur centered on the mouse cursor with temporal blur trail persistence, chromatic radial streak separation, depth-scaled blur attenuation, dithered sampling, and audio-reactive intensity.

name: Julia Warp
description: Julia fractal-based warping with orbit traps for psychedelic coloring.

name: Rose FBM Kaleidoscope
description: Rose-FBM kaleidoscope whose mirror bank is now steerable: the segment fan pivots and re-centres on a spring-damped pointer in extraBuffer[133..134] instead of being pinned to frame centre, and each mirror segment owns one FFT bin driving its own petal amplitude and Gabor texture gain. Fixes a shader that never read the mouse at all, and adds the dataTextureA writeback the slot was missing.

updatedParams.name: Segments
updatedParams.description: Number of mirror wedges in the fan.

updatedParams.name: Edge Softness
updatedParams.description: Wedge edge feathering; also sets the superellipse aperture exponent and the per-segment RGB split.

description: Ripple glass with wavelength-correct Cauchy dispersion: n(lambda) = A + B/lambda^2 sets each channel's sample offset, so blue bends hardest as real glass does. Fixes the dead-audio bug where u.config.y (the ripple count) was read as an audio level. Clicks emit bounded caustic wavefronts.
name: Liquid Prism

updatedParams.name: Prism Strength
updatedParams.description: Displacement amplitude of the refraction ripple.

updatedParams.name: Wave Frequency
updatedParams.description: Ripple wavenumber; mids and the local FFT band modulate it.

updatedParams.name: Flow Speed
updatedParams.description: Phase speed of the pointer ripple.

updatedParams.name: Aberration / Transparency
updatedParams.description: Dual-purpose: scales the Cauchy index spread AND sets base glass transparency.

description: Swirls the image around the cursor like mixing paint.
name: Liquid Swirl
Liquid Warp
description: Liquid curl warp with conveyor flow, liquid-rainbow ripples, held pull, bounded click fronts. Display RGBA in A.

name: Log-Polar Droste
description: Infinite recursive zoom with spiral distortion creating Droste/Escher-like effects.

name: Luma Glass
description: Physically-based refraction shader where luminance drives glass refractive index. Features Sellmeier chromatic dispersion, caustic highlights, Fresnel reflections, and subsurface scattering.
Glass tiles that refract based on video brightness and mouse interaction.
name: Luminescent Glass
Magnetic Field
description: Multipole magnetic field where each pole draws its moment from one of the eight FFT bins, so the field geometry itself reshapes with the music. Luminous tracer bands advect along the field lines at a cyclotron rate set by local |B|, streaming fast in strong regions and stalling in weak ones. Fixes a mask-as-colour feedback bug: dataTextureA stored the raw B-field vector while the temporal blend read it back as RGB, injecting signed field components into the displayed colour.

updatedParams.name: Field Strength
updatedParams.description: Lorentz displacement gain applied to the image.

updatedParams.name: Field Radius
updatedParams.description: Extent of the field envelope around the pointer.

updatedParams.name: Line Density
updatedParams.description: Spacing of the field-line caustic ridges and tracer bands.

updatedParams.name: Field Mode
updatedParams.description: Monopole / dipole / multipole / solenoid vortex geometry.

description: Uses luminance as depth to create a mouse-controlled 3D parallax effect.
name: Parallax Shift
Perspective Tilt
description: Rotates the image plane in 3D space based on mouse position (Pitch/Yaw). Zoom param adjusts distance.

params.name: Y-Axis Tilt (Pitch)
params.description: Enable or scale pitch tilt amount

name: Phase Shift
description: RGB channels are rotationally shifted relative to the mouse position.

name: Pixel Sort Glitch
description: Edge-aware pixel sorting glitch with threshold masking. Creates melting pixels that flow along detected edges. Features horizontal, vertical, and angular sorting directions with adjustable window size and edge influence.

params.name: Brightness Threshold
params.description: Pixels brighter than this threshold will be sorted; darks are protected

params.name: Sort Window Size
params.description: Size of the local window for sorting (1-32 pixels)

params.name: Edge Influence
params.description: How much detected edges affect sorting direction and flow

name: Pixel Storm
description: Mouse movement creates a chaotic storm of pixels.

name: Pixelate Blast
description: Catalog entry for Pixelate Blast.

name: Predator Camouflage
description: Stylized active-camouflage treatment with false-color thermal mapping, fast pigment-sac runners and hunt sweeps, held-pointer cloaking, click fronts, depth-shaped haze, bloom, and chromatic separation.

name: Prism Lens
description: Prismatic lens effect with chromatic angular dispersion, temporal lens rotation memory, depth-weighted magnification, audio-reactive refraction responding to bass, and edge shine.

name: Prismatic Mosaic
description: Color tiles break apart and reassemble into shifting prisms, turning strong colors into a kaleidoscopic mosaic that ripples across the image.

name: Radial RGB
description: Spectral chromatic aberration with lens distortion, anamorphic stretch, single-sample spectral tint via mix(), alpha translucency blending, and vignette.

name: Refraction Tunnel
description: Chromatic refraction tunnel with wall ribs, hoop rings, helical rails, analytic liquid-rainbow caustics, held aim, and bounded click shock rings. Display RGBA is packed in A.

name: Scan Distort Matrix gpt52
description: High-density scanlines with smooth multi-band jitter, opposing scan heads, diagonal tear conveyors, held-pointer band pulling, bounded click shocks, curvature, domain-warped FBM, and audio-reactive chromatic grading.

name: Sine Wave
description: Multi-frequency sine wave interference with fast traveling packets, crest-aligned history streaks, click wave fronts, water-like caustics, chromatic dispersion, and bounded specular highlights. Bass drives wave amplitude and depth controls attenuation.

name: Bicubic Crystal
description: Bicubic Catmull-Rom crystalline distortion. Full 16-sample bicubic interpolation for perfectly smooth magnification, applied to prismatic crystalline faceting with chromatic separation.

name: Spectral Vortex
description: Spectral curl distortion whose authoritative A feedback packs phase, curl, and energy; sprung pointer and bounded click vortices drive three-band motion while source depth passes through unchanged.

name: Spiral Lens
description: Liquid rainbow interference through a Möbius kaleidoscopic lens, with spectral caustics, drag-twisted focus, bounded click-launched iris waves, domain warp, audio response, and layered depth alpha.

name: Temporal Distortion Field
description: Stylized temporal distortion with exact display-history feedback, depth-weighted freeze radius, moving clock rings, held freeze, click fronts, and chromatic lag.

name: Tensor Flow Sculpt
description: Catalog entry for Tensor Flow Sculpt.

name: Voronoi Chaos
description: Animated Voronoi mosaic with moving ridge runners, held cell repulsion, click fronts, three-band audio, bounded source sampling, and psychedelic cell color.

name: Voronoi Faceted Glass
description: Cellular glass distortion effect.

name: Lamb-Oseen Vortex
description: Lamb-Oseen vortex fluid dynamics with Kelvin-Helmholtz shear instability at vortex boundaries. Multiple interacting vortices from ripple history, velocity-magnitude and vorticity colour coding with chromatic aberration.

name: Clean Vortex (Pass 1)
description: Vortex dynamics pass: four animated vortex centers, Biot-Savart velocity field, vorticity confinement, and turbulent FBM noise. Outputs velocity and vorticity field to dataTextureA.

name: Vortex Warp
description: Rankine vortex warp: solid-body rotation inside the core radius and free-vortex circulation (omega ~ 1/r^2) outside it, giving a tightly spun core with a slower, longer-reaching outer flow instead of a rigidly rotating disc. The vortex eye is spring-damped through extraBuffer[133..136] and its own velocity shears the flow, so whipping the cursor drags the vortex behind the pointer. Retains the FFT-banded azimuthal turbulence and flow-aligned angular dispersion from Batch 56.

updatedParams.name: Vortex Strength
updatedParams.description: Circulation gain of the Rankine profile; bass adds up to +45%.

updatedParams.name: Radius
updatedParams.description: Vortex extent; also sets the solid-body core radius.

updatedParams.name: Spiral Twist
updatedParams.description: Radius-dependent spiral layered on the circulation.

updatedParams.name: Turbulence
updatedParams.description: Gain on the FFT-banded azimuthal lobes.

name: Zoom Burst
description: Exponential zoom burst with radial motion blur, angular streak sampling, starburst light rays, chromatic radial dispersion, HDR bloom, film grain, and ACES tone mapping. Bass accelerates the burst; mouse positions the center; depth controls streak perspective.
